title: The Choir Missing a Voice
text: Light stands in rows in the ruined nave and sings, a hymn older than the walls around it. There is a gap in the middle row the shape of a person. Every time the song reaches it, the music stumbles, and the whole choir turns its faceless heads to look at you.

options.label: Let your wisest step into the gap.

outcomes.text: They take the missing part. The song ends, and the light that was singing it stays inside them.
They sing it once, perfectly, and the choir lets them go with a blessing.

options.label: Sit at the back and listen.

outcomes.text: Nobody speaks for a long time afterwards. Nobody needs to.
